failure_mode.evidence: EXERCISED as a self-consistency control rather than a retrieval probe, because this artifact has no lookup API -- it is ingested wholesale. The control that COULD have failed: recomputing the counts block from the nodes and edges arrays. It agreed on every field. A corrupted or truncated file would have produced a mismatch here, so the arms were reachable from different truths. ⛔ WHAT IS NOT COVERED: the file carries no schema version and no checksum, so a consumer ingesting a MALFORMED copy has nothing to check against except this same self-declared counts block -- which a corrupted producer would have rewritten too.
failure_mode.returns_on_failure: no lookup surface; a malformed file surfaces only as a downstream parse error in the derive, not as a signal from the artifact
silent_degrade_paths: a frozen spec silently continues to type today's instances against a July class vocabulary, and nothing in the artifact signals its own age to the derive

verdict.why: A frozen, tracked, self-declaring artifact whose internal counts control checks out exactly -- and which is STILL BEING CONSUMED, measured, not assumed. QUALIFIED on two axes and NOT on its age: it declares a class vocabulary by hand inside a rung whose canon says C2 is discovered rather than declared, and it carries no version or checksum, so its only integrity signal is a counts block a corrupted producer would also rewrite. ⛔ THIS CARD DELIBERATELY MAKES NO STATEMENT ABOUT THIS ARTIFACT'S FUTURE. It is in use today; that is the measurement, and the fate question is a separate pass.
